name: Barbarian: Body Builder adds 75% of Strength as melee attack power only while Strength is lower than unbuffed Agility
contract: Body Builder (706481) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT (268), amount 75, MiscValue 0 = Strength. Its periodic companion 706508 carries the condition in the client tooltip: 'when your Strength is lower than your Agility your melee attack power is further increased by $s1% of your Strength', matching the bindmysoul.com CoA talent snapshot of 2026-07-22. Maintainer decision 2026-11-16: the bonus applies only while Strength is lower than Agility, and the comparison uses Agility without buffs (create stat plus the BASE_VALUE layer that item stats use; aura buffs and enchants are excluded). A level 60 human Barbarian starts with Strength 86 and Agility 133 (player_class_stats class 12 level 60, race 1 adds 0). Low side: learning Body Builder raises melee attack power by 0.75 x 86 = 64.5. High side: Juju Power (16323, SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT Strength) with amount 200 lifts Strength to 286, above Agility; learning Body Builder adds nothing. Buffed side: the Agility scroll aura (8115, SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT Agility) with amount 200 lifts current Agility to 333, above Strength 286, while unbuffed Agility stays 133; Body Builder still adds nothing. Absence is checked after the aura is confirmed active and a further wait. Bands are the exact values widened for integer stat and attack power rounding.
